description: The NANCY project publishes round-trip-time series from an Italian in-lab MEC-assisted 5G fronthaul testbed. Zenodo lists a public archive plus a three-page README under CC BY 4.0. A Pixel 7 handset and a video streaming/transcoding application exchanged ten-minute streams at several resolutions in both uplink and downlink roles. The README describes one-second ping samples with 64, 708 and 1,358 byte payloads, plus gNB bit-rate traces and no-traffic baseline measurements. These measurements can calibrate latency assumptions for mobile edge-service or 5G network simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this testbed release. A limitation is that the tests use a fixed laboratory topology and a single handset, not representative public-network congestion or mobile handover. The README lists a 4320p naming option while the prose reports tests through 2160p; actual files were not opened to resolve this discrepancy. The archive was not downloaded, and RTT values were not recomputed.
